Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee Meeting of February 3-4, 1998 A meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee was held in
the offices of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System in
Washington, D.C., on Tuesday, February 3, 1998 at 2:30 p.m. and
